fields.description: Snake-cased name the LLM sees. Used as the unique identifier.
fields.label: Slug

fields.description: Imported tools are loaded from a Python module by path. Script tools store code in the database and run it in a safe_exec sandbox. Server tools are extension tools the flow server loaded, mirrored here by the app.
fields.label: Type

fields.description: Pause the run and ask the user to approve each call before this tool executes.
fields.label: Requires Confirmation

fields.description: Run each call in a background job, so a slow tool doesn't hold a web worker.
fields.label: Run in Background

fields.description: Defined in code and owned by it: the Desk can only enable or disable the tool.
fields.label: System Generated

fields.description: Shown to the LLM. Should state what the tool does and how to interpret the return value.
fields.label: Description (LLM-facing)

fields.description: Optional plain-English summary for human reviewers.
fields.label: Summary (human-facing)

fields.description: Dotted Python path to the Tool object, e.g. frappe.flow.tools.builtins.search_doctypes.
fields.label: Import Path

fields.description: Python source. Must define a top-level main function. Executed in a server-script sandbox. Requires server scripts to be enabled in the bench configuration.
fields.label: Code
